data.title: 迦摩 · 连败之后的重开按钮
data.description: 迦摩穿紫色卫衣和灰色家居长裤，盘腿坐在地毯上看着游戏失败的抽象色块。她把手柄放下，抱起旁边的靠垫沉默两秒，又不服输地伸手拿回来；台灯照亮白发与微皱的眉。
data.action: 抱靠垫停顿片刻，又伸手拿回游戏手柄。
data.promptProse: After losing another round, Kama sets the controller on the carpet and hugs a cushion in stubborn silence, then reaches to play again. Violet sweatshirt, charcoal joggers and indoor socks cover her cross-legged pose beneath white hair and a determined red-eyed frown. The close medium view includes cushion and controller, television outside the frame. Soft table-lamp light illuminates her reaching hand and face, leaving gentle contact shadows across the carpet.
